notes.title: Hello friends!
notes.notes:
[b]We are constantly improving and adding new features to the program. With each new release, Movavi Photo Editor gets smarter, faster, and offers more functionality.[/b]

[h3]The main updates are:
[/h3]
[b][list]
[*] Easier working with photos thanks to the fully refreshed interface

[*] New and expanded collection of image backgrounds: see yourself at a long-awaited concert or in a mysterious forest, walk down a busy street, travel through the galaxy, and more

[*] New text adornments: a search box, hearts and stars, speech bubbles, ribbons, plates, and other backgrounds for every occasion

[*] Bug fixes
[/list][/b]

notes.title: Meet the new Photo Editor 23!
notes.notes:
[b]Level up with the new Movavi Photo Editor! Reignite the photos you took this summer to make a bonfire of awesome![/b]
[h3]Highlights[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Presets
[/b]Now you can take advantage of presets – and add your own preset to make it easier to adjust the colors.
[*] [b]AI photo colorization[/b]
Use the built-in AI to get your pictures in roaring color!
[*] [b]AI object removal[/b]
Erase things you don’t want in your shots with AI-powered precision. Let those random objects vanish into thin air. Don’t settle for less than perfect!
[*][b] AI retoucher[/b]
Get rid of skin blemishes you find uncool in your selfies. Lose the acne, wrinkles, and everything in between with the new discreet AI retoucher!
[*] [b]New name, same great quality[/b]
We've changed the main color from pink to yellow, name, and icon.[/list]
